verdict.rationale: incident.io publishes a documented API reference with an API key requirement and downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 specs (per-tag, confirmed live via probe), which is the foundation for an API reference, but there is no evidence of an interactive 'try it' console or runnable code examples within the docs. Missing for 10: explicit interactive try-it-out UI, runnable/executable code samples, and multi-language SDK snippets in the reference.
